ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels dominate >90% of the visible area, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized in discrete, sparse clusters and linear marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black pigmentation across the central and basal regions. High-contrast white clusters are mapped to the distal tips of both lobes and distributed in various linear and circular patterns across the fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a central convergence point; interior pixel angle approximately 55 degrees with a well-defined vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge. The left lobe exhibits fine, closely spaced peaks, while the right lobe shows more pronounced, jagged irregular valleys towards the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning into an upward-sloping trajectory toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast circular white nodes (approx. 5-15 pixels in diameter) concentrated on the left distal edge and scattered in the lower-right quadrant of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-intensity linear disruptions. A series of parallel vertical marks are located on the left distal tip. Two prominent, nearly vertical white rake marks (approx. 100-150 pixels in length) are visible on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring and irregular pigmentation loss at the distal tips; distinct white circular scars consistent with sessile organism attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense grouping of roughly 8-10 parallel vertical white lines at the far-left lobe margin, creating a unique comb-like visual pattern.
